chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, both together, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Dawud ibn Sirhan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When he enters her (completes penetration), then the ritual bath (ghusl) becomes obligatory, and the whipping, and the stoning, and the dower becomes obligatory.
ai.seo_question: What are the legal obligations triggered by sexual penetration in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that full sexual penetration (dakhil) is the decisive criterion for imposing the major penalties of zina, specifically distinguishing the liability for rajm (stoning) which applies to the married offender, alongside the general hadd punishment of jald. It further establishes the immediate obligation of the complete dower (mahr al-mithl) for the woman, reflecting the Shia juristic view that penetration validates the right to full compensation even in the context of unlawful union. This ruling underscores the interplay between ritual purity (ghusl) and legal liability in Shia fiqh.
